$comment: Casebook tokens. The source for app/tokens.css (npm run tokens) and for every brand asset (npm run brand). The Casebook design system on claude.ai documents the same values with usage notes; change them here first.

themes.paper: The site, the CV and every light asset.
themes.ink: Dark GitHub assets only. The site never uses it.

color.name: paper
color.usage: The ground: page background on the site, banner and preview grounds, the mark's tile. In Ink it is the dark ground of GitHub assets. The CV prints on the sheet itself and takes no ground fill.

color.name: paper-band
color.usage: A second surface one step off the ground, with no border: the OSUS band on the site, a relief block on banners. Text on it uses ink, ink-soft or ink-faint; all three hold 4.5:1 here in both themes.

color.name: ink
color.usage: Headings, the wordmark, running text on paper and paper-band. 15.9:1 and 14.6:1 in Paper; 15.9:1 and 14.5:1 in Ink.

color.name: ink-soft
color.usage: Section intros, chapter prose, asides, on paper and paper-band. 8.1:1 and 7.4:1 in Paper; 10.7:1 and 9.8:1 in Ink.

color.name: ink-faint
color.usage: Eyebrow labels, figure captions, dates and dimension ticks, on paper and paper-band. 5.3:1 and 4.9:1 in Paper; 6.4:1 and 5.8:1 in Ink. Faint still means readable: never lighter than this.

color.name: rule
color.usage: Hairlines only: 1px rules under headings, between chapters, around figures, across banners. Never a border that makes a card. Not for text.

color.name: accent
color.usage: The one drawing blue: links, the mark's letter, the highlighted path in a schematic, text selection, the boot screen's highlights. As text on paper it holds 5.6:1 in Paper and 6.8:1 in Ink. Nothing else on a page is colored.

color.name: on-accent
color.usage: Text and marks on an `accent` fill only, which on the site is the text selection. An alias of `paper`, so it follows the ground: 5.6:1 on `accent` in Paper, 6.5:1 on `accent` in Ink. Never set it on `paper` itself.

color.name: tone-blue
color.usage: OSUS band only, Paper only: the status dot and status line of the featured product. Muted print tone, never a link color.

color.name: tone-green
color.usage: OSUS band only, Paper only: status of a live or green-tested project.

color.name: tone-amber
color.usage: OSUS band only, Paper only: status of a pre-alpha project.

color.name: tone-red
color.usage: OSUS band only, Paper only: the Bubbles tone. Not an error color; the site has no error states.

color.name: crt
color.usage: Boot screen ground only. It is the one surface outside the paper world and it lasts under three seconds.

color.name: crt-hi
color.usage: Boot screen highlights on crt: the casebook tint of the old phosphor green. 7.6:1.

mark.note: The D drawn as a casebook figure. The Ink version is produced by scripts/brand.mjs from the same geometry.
